items.title: 68097_Freddie Green oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Paul Gonsalves was in the band. ... [INTERVIEWER] Well, Stanley, so -- once Walter Page and Jo Jones were back -- read us off the line-up of the band there, will you?

ctx.x: Paul and Buddy are the two guys.
Well, Paul wasn't in it very long, was he?
